title: Laredo Police Arrest 19 in Halloween Weekend No-Refusal DWI Crackdown
excerpt: Laredo police arrested 19 people for driving while intoxicated over Halloween weekend under a No-Refusal initiative, according to KGNS.
content:
Laredo police arrested 19 people for driving while intoxicated over Halloween weekend, according to KGNS.

The arrests came during a targeted enforcement crackdown conducted under a No-Refusal DWI initiative. Under that initiative, officers could obtain search warrants for blood samples from drivers who declined field sobriety or breath testing. According to KGNS, only two of the 19 people arrested refused to provide a voluntary sample.

The operation involved County Court at Law No. 2 Judge Victor Villarreal, Webb County District Attorney Isidro Alaniz, Doctors Hospital, and the Texas Department of Transportation, according to KGNS.

KGNS also reported at least one traffic crash over the weekend that may have involved an intoxicated driver, and that authorities described impaired driving as a serious danger. Those arrested have been charged, not convicted, and are presumed innocent unless proven guilty in court.

Although the holiday operation has ended, KGNS reported that DWI patrols remain an ongoing priority, and drivers are advised to designate a sober driver or use a rideshare service.
